newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland plans to privatise TAB - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland plans to privatise TAB - paper.

text.p: The Queensland state government has plans for a A$300 million privatisation of its Totalisator Agency Board (TAB) betting monopoly within the next year, the Courier Mail newspaper said on Thursday.
A report on the privatisation is being prepared by Macquarie Bank Ltd and is expected to be presented to state Racing Minister Russell Cooper next month, the report said.

The chief executive of the Queensland TAB, Dick McIlwain, said in the report that he had urged the state government to take measures to enable the TAB to expand its operations and diversify revenue streams.
McIlwain told the newspaper privatisation of the Queensland TAB would enable expansion into new areas of gambling.

"Because of the privatisation of the Victorian TAB and the potential sale of the NSW (New South Wales) TAB and the circumstances we are working in, it isn't an option for the government to do nothing," McIlwain said.
